data.title: 'Diesel Season' Is Starting. There's No Escaping Record Prices.
data.description: As a result of geopolitical violence causing disruptions in Russian refineries, the Strait of Hormuz, and the Red Sea, diesel prices are continuously rising. This surge in fuel costs is affecting everyone. The onset of "Diesel Season" is marking the beginning of record-high prices. With no escape in sight, consumers are facing the impact of these escalating costs.

data.title: Chip Stocks Hit Ceiling During Sector Rebound. Macom Is A Standout.
data.description: The SOX, or Philadelphia semiconductor index, experienced its fourth straight day of gains on Friday, driven by a surge in chip stocks. A standout performer was Macom, as chip stocks reached a new peak during a sector rebound. The uptick in chip stocks was reported by Investor's Business Daily.

data.title: Netflix Stock Downgraded To Sell As Viewer Engagement Wanes
data.description: The stock of the streaming video giant Netflix plummeted on Friday following a downgrade by a Wall Street analyst to a sell rating. This downgrade resulted in a significant decrease in viewer engagement, causing the stock to fall sharply. The downgrade signals concern about the company's future performance, with shares experiencing a notable decline in value as a result.

data.title: These Steelmakers Sink To Bottom Of S&P 500 After Issuing Weak Guidance
data.description: Leading steel producers Nucor and Steel Dynamics have provided forecasts that fall short of Wall Street estimates. Despite reporting continued strength in demand and pricing, both companies issued guidance that disappointed investors. Consequently, these steelmakers saw their stock prices plummet, landing them at the lowest positions on the S&P 500 index.

data.title: When OpenAI, Anthropic CEOs Warned Of 'AI Extinction Risk'
data.description: Tech leaders issued warnings about the risks of AI extinction long before Pope Leo raised concerns. Now, as fears intensify, the stakes are higher. Chief executive officers of OpenAI and Anthropic have previously cautioned about the potential threats posed by AI. This highlights the growing apprehension surrounding the future implications of artificial intelligence.

This decision marks a significant milestone for the college and the community as Dr. Heafner takes on this leadership role.

data.title: Grupo Bimbo Recognized as One of TIME’s World’s Best Companies
data.description: Based in Mexico City, Grupo Bimbo, the world's top baking company, has earned a notable honor by being featured in the prestigious World’s Best Companies 2026 list. This recognition marks their third inclusion in the ranking, compiled by TIME in collaboration with Statista. Recognized as the largest of its kind globally, Grupo Bimbo continues to make an impact on the industry.

data.title: Binance introduces 24/7 FX perpetual futures with weekend pricing, joining other exchanges in offering continuous foreign exchange market access.
data.description: Binance has joined the increasing number of cryptocurrency exchanges providing 24/7 access to the foreign exchange markets through perpetual futures contracts.

data.description: Roundtable has announced that it will not be acquiring PAAI as a private stock sale is a prerequisite for the deal to go through. data.title: Fathom Statement on Governor Newsom's Executive Order to Accelerate Independent Verification of AI
data.description: Governor Newsom of California has accelerated the implementation timeline for SB 813, the initial all-encompassing independent verification law in the country. The order also assembles national specialists to explore areas where independent verification could have a greater impact. This move was made on September 18, 2026, in Sacramento.

data.title: Calavera New York Unveils Redesigned Website, Expanding into Fine Gemstones, New Jewelry Categories, and AI-Powered Shopping
data.description: A recent launch of a new platform in New York provides shoppers with access to a vast selection of over 2 million diamonds and gemstones, along with a variety of new jewelry styles and bespoke design services. This platform also offers the assistance of an AI Gemologist to assist customers in making informed purchases. The platform belongs to Calavera New York, a renowned diamond retailer and jewelry brand located in Manhattan. The platform was unveiled on September 18, 2026.

data.title: Portland Craft Chocolate Festival Returns Oct. 2-4 with 45+ Oregon Makers -- and 300+ Entries for Portland's Best Chocolate Chip Cookie
data.description: The Ranger Chocolate Co.-sponsored second annual festival in Portland's Central Eastside is set to be bigger than ever. Highlights include the C⁴ Chocolate Chip Cookie Competition, a collaboration between Steven Smith Teamaker and Ranger Chocolate Co. introducing new bonbons, as well as offerings from Stumptown Coffee Roasters. The event will also feature a variety of family-friendly activities throughout the weekend, making it a celebration not to miss.

data.title: She Learned to Fly at 49. Now She Wants the Next Generation of Girls to Look Up
data.description: An owner of a flight school in Sedona, Arizona is urging girls not to avoid flying. On September 19, 2026, International Girls in Aviation Day will be celebrated for the 12th year. This day promotes females of all ages to explore flying.

data.title: What Can Twelve People and a 12,000 Year Old Pair of Dice Teach a Distracted Culture?
data.description: In Los Angeles on September 18, 2026, Kobold Press participated in an episode of "All Access with Andy Garcia". This independent publisher, known for Tales of the Valiant, discussed the impact of collaborative storytelling in an upcoming segment. The feature will delve into how this practice fosters literacy, teamwork, and community values.
